topic: Kizaru's friendships with Sentomaru, Bonney and Kuma make his attacks hit harder: a side point of the long, not its verdict
title: Kizaru's Friends Make His Attacks Hurt More
description: Kizaru trained Sentomaru as a boy and spent six months befriending Bonney and Kuma on Egghead. Here's why that history makes his Egghead attacks land harder, and whether Oda wrote it that way on purpose.
comment: Is Kizaru's history with Bonney and Kuma a real character choice, or just a way to make the Egghead fights hurt?

lines.text: Kizaru attacks the people he likes, and that's no accident.

shot.fallback: tall admiral in a yellow suit standing beside a calm ally

lines.text: He befriended Bonney and Kuma, spending six months with them on Egghead.

shot.fallback: admiral eating and laughing with a giant warlord and a young woman

lines.text: Sentomaru calls him uncle, because Kizaru trained him back when he was a boy.

shot.fallback: young boy beside a smiling admiral

lines.text: Here's my read. A stranger hitting Sentomaru is a fight. An uncle doing it is a tragedy.

shot.fallback: bodyguard standing firm against an admiral

lines.text: Oda makes sure you remember that history when the attack lands.

shot.fallback: light beam hitting a bodyguard in a white lab

lines.text: Then the same light turns on Bonney and Kuma, the friends he made.

shot.fallback: admiral firing a beam at a pale young woman

lines.text: The Pacifista laser is based on his own light power.

shot.fallback: giant laser cannon glowing over a white lab

lines.text: The friendships don't soften him. They make every hit land harder.

shot.fallback: young woman staring in shock at a light beam

lines.text: So does an admiral who hurts friends for orders ever choose anything?

shot.fallback: relaxed admiral with a faint smile

lines.text: Because Kizaru hurts the people he likes, and that's why it stings.

shot.fallback: admiral looking away from a fallen friend

self_check.hook: Opens on a flat, checkable claim about who Kizaru attacks, before any evidence.
self_check.loop: Last line leads back into line 1: he attacks the people he likes, and that is why it stings.
